policy.causal_rule: A repository workflow capability is evidence of a possible control path, not proof that it caused a historical event. Invalid provider output is not a price forecast.

edges.claim: The current main signal records missing GitHub model credentials and Groq HTTP 429 while confidence is 0.0. The score/headline blend is not a valid directional forecast; forecast status remains NOT_ISSUED.

Main still schedules the paper trader every 30 minutes and commits/pushes its state/log. The persisted nonzero position has position_product=null. PR #1320 proposes to remove the schedule and fail closed but is unmerged.

Main merge-queue workflow has write permissions and commands for branch updates, comments, PR merges and branch deletion. This is a credible risk path but does not prove causality for any prior unexpected merge. PR #1323 proposes a read-only replacement and has not yet produced visible CI/gate evidence.

hypotheses.statement: A prior unexpected PR merge may have used the mutation-capable merge-queue workflow, but direct API/CLI action or another authorized automation remains plausible.
disconfirming_evidence: No run-level evidence in this capture ties the workflow to the historical merge; the workflow is manually dispatched rather than scheduled.
tests_needed: Inspect historical workflow runs and audit logs with authorized access; compare actor, event, run inputs, merge timestamp, and merge commit. Do not infer cause from capability alone.

hypotheses.statement: The headline-only news score may be descriptive context, but it cannot substitute for a model forecast when the sentiment provider fails and confidence is zero.
disconfirming_evidence: The news score may still be useful as a separately labeled descriptive feature after source quality, asset relevance, timestamp, duplication and event-impact checks.
tests_needed: Keep news score separate from forecast score; require immutable target/horizon/probability records and evaluate incremental out-of-sample value against a baseline.

notes: PR #1319 and PR #1320 have passing exact-head CI and fail-closed gates but remain unmerged.
PR #1323 is a fresh-main read-only merge-queue proposal; its CI/gate status was not visible at snapshot cutoff.
PR #1308 still proposes removal of one unintended data-only graph file from main; it remains unmerged.
No market observations were admitted and no forecast was issued.
